section_summary.extract_value: Study X recruited individuals who identified as or had been socialized as female; of 494 registrants 247 completed relevant items (mean age 29.76, SD 7.77). Ethnicity was recorded for 189 participants (66.8% White, n = 165), 83.0% (205/246) had an undergraduate degree or higher, and most participants identified as female (97.6%, n = 241) and were partnered (74.5%, n = 184).
